purpose: Existing dark glass solid/impulse body levels; no render, fit, or T1/L1 change.

supportDefinitions.deep8: W44 signed_distance at pixel centres <= -8 * scale device px.
supportDefinitions.core24: Same supplied-path signed_distance <= -24 * scale device px; diagnostic only.
supportDefinitions.deep8_far16: deep8 AND >=16 CSS px centre distance to every nonzero no-glass impulse raster pixel; smaller-span supporting cut.
supportDefinitions.deep8_far24: deep8 AND >=24 CSS px centre distance to every nonzero no-glass impulse raster pixel.
supportDefinitions.core24_far24: core24 AND >=24 CSS px centre distance to every nonzero no-glass impulse raster pixel.
supportDefinitions.deep8_far32: deep8 AND >=32 CSS px centre distance to every nonzero no-glass impulse raster pixel.
supportDefinitions.farRestrictions: Selected pixels are asserted RGB [0,0,0] in the no-glass background; this does not make the group/silhouette tone input zero.
supportDefinitions.statistic: Encoded RGB/luma codes 0..255; linear luminance is per-channel sRGB decode then Rec.709 weights; population means/medians on the SAME mask for both images.

solidDarkScene.$comment: System dark. Pairs with the dark-scheme profiles.

uniformPureBlack.qualification: dark-solid is [28,28,30], not black. Impulse field is black away from dots, but its aggregate tone input is nonzero.

rest.qualification: Named/inherited patch leaves only, not a reconstructed complete default material.

inactive.qualification: Named/inherited patch leaves only, not a reconstructed complete default material.
